release_notes: A virtually-untraded deep ITM leg's best bid/ask could itself be mispriced — confirmed live 2026-08-24: NIFTY26AUG25950PE (1 DTE) had its MARKET close rejected ("no trades in this instrument") and the depth-based LIMIT fallback crossed into a thin, mispriced bid ~80pts below the leg's own intrinsic value. `_marketable_limit_price` now clamps toward intrinsic (a SELL never goes below it, a BUY never above), threaded through `place_order`/`convert_to_limit` across Kite/Breeze/Dhan adapters and `strategies/engine.py`'s close/retry path. Unconfirmed closes now stash the full leg so the retry can re-place it the same way a fresh close would.
